premise: On a snowy day Fox and Squirrel argue whose tail is best, the biggest or the bushiest, until tiny Caterpillar shivers in the snow — and both tails curl round her.
inspiration: The boast undone (Aesop's fables of vanity, like the peacock's tail), turned: nobody is humbled; the boast simply turns into kindness, and the best tail is the one round a friend.
lesson: The best thing about what you have is sharing it.
learning: Foxes and squirrels curl their bushy tails around them like a blanket in the cold.

en-US.title: The Warmest Tail
en-US.text: {canvas:snow 0.5} {sfx:hush} Snowflakes were drifting down on the meadow. {fox:enter} Fox {fox:pulse} swished his tail. [excited] "My tail is the biggest in the forest!" {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to fox} Squirrel came bounding up. {squirrel:face happy} "Mine is the BUSHIEST!" And she {squirrel:live hide-nut} tucked her hazelnut behind her back, to show her tail off. "Biggest!" {squirrel:hop} "Bushiest!" {fox:hop} "BIGGEST!" {squirrel:wobble} "BUSHIEST!" {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to fox} "Mouse, you choose!" said Fox. {mouse:pulse} Mouse looked at one tail, then the other. "Hmm…" Then {fox:live listen hold} Fox's ears pricked up. [whispers] "Shhh. What's that?" {sfx:brrr} Brrr… brrr… It was little {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar, {caterpillar:shake} shivering in the snow. {caterpillar:tint #A8D8FF} {caterpillar:face sad} [softly] "So cold," she said. {fox:live listen resume} {fox:face happy} Fox didn't say a word. {fox:go to caterpillar} He trotted straight over and {fox:live wrap-tail hold} curled his big tail round her, the way foxes do on chilly nights. {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:go to caterpillar} Squirrel bounded over and {squirrel:live wrap-tail hold} curled hers round too. {caterpillar:face happy} {caterpillar:hearts} Warm at last, Caterpillar {caterpillar:live look-up} looked up at the snowflakes. "Well?" said Mouse. "Which tail is best?" [happily] "Both," said Caterpillar. "Snug as a bug."

es-ES.title: La cola más calentita
es-ES.text: {canvas:snow 0.5} {sfx:hush} Caían copos de nieve sobre el prado. {fox:enter} Zorro {fox:pulse} meneó la cola. [excited] —¡Mi cola es la más grande del bosque! {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to fox} Ardilla llegó dando saltos. {squirrel:face happy} —¡Pues la mía es la más PELUDA! Y {squirrel:live hide-nut} se escondió la avellana a la espalda, para lucir bien la cola. —¡La más grande! {squirrel:hop} —¡La más peluda! {fox:hop} —¡GRANDE! {squirrel:wobble} —¡PELUDA! {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to fox} —Ratón, elige tú —dijo Zorro. {mouse:pulse} Ratón miró una cola, y luego la otra. —Mmm… Entonces Zorro {fox:live listen hold} levantó las orejas. [whispers] —Chsss. ¿Qué es eso? {sfx:brrr} Brrr… brrr… Era la pequeña {caterpillar:enter} Oruga, {caterpillar:shake} tiritando en la nieve. {caterpillar:tint #A8D8FF} {caterpillar:face sad} [softly] —Qué frío —dijo. {fox:live listen resume} {fox:face happy} Zorro no dijo nada. {fox:go to caterpillar} Fue derecho hacia ella y {fox:live wrap-tail hold} la rodeó con su cola grande, como hacen los zorros en las noches frías. {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:go to caterpillar} Ardilla se acercó también y {squirrel:live wrap-tail hold} la arropó con la suya. {caterpillar:face happy} {caterpillar:hearts} Calentita por fin, Oruga {caterpillar:live look-up} miró caer los copos. —¿Y bien? —dijo Ratón—. ¿Cuál es la mejor cola? [happily] —Las dos —dijo Oruga—. ¡Qué gustito!

ja-JP.title: いちばん あったかい しっぽ
ja-JP.text: {canvas:snow 0.5}{sfx:hush}のはらに、雪がちらちらふっています。{fox:enter}キツネくんが、{fox:pulse}しっぽをふりふり。[excited]「ぼくのしっぽは、森でいちばん大きいんだ！」 {squirrel:enter}{squirrel:go to fox}リスさんが、ぴょんぴょん。{squirrel:face happy}「わたしのは、いちばんふさふさよ！」 そして{squirrel:live hide-nut}木の実をせなかにかくして、しっぽをじまん。「大きい！」 {squirrel:hop}「ふさふさ！」 {fox:hop}「大きいってば！」 {squirrel:wobble}「ふさふさだってば！」 {mouse:enter}{mouse:go to fox}「ネズミくん、きめて！」 とキツネくん。{mouse:pulse}ネズミくんは、こっちを見て、あっちを見て、「うーん…」 そのとき、{fox:live listen hold}キツネくんの耳が、ぴくっ。[whispers]「しーっ。なんの音？」 {sfx:brrr}ぶるぶる…ぶるぶる…小さな{caterpillar:enter}あおむしさんが、{caterpillar:shake}雪のなかでふるえていました。{caterpillar:tint #A8D8FF}{caterpillar:face sad}[softly]「さむいよう」 {fox:live listen resume}{fox:face happy}キツネくんは、なんにもいわずに{fox:go to caterpillar}かけよると、{fox:live wrap-tail hold}さむい夜にキツネがするように、大きなしっぽでくるりとつつみました。{squirrel:face happy}{squirrel:go to caterpillar}リスさんもかけよって、{squirrel:live wrap-tail hold}ふさふさのしっぽで、くるり。{caterpillar:face happy}{caterpillar:hearts}あったまったあおむしさんは、{caterpillar:live look-up}雪を見上げました。「で、どっちのしっぽがいちばん？」 とネズミくん。[happily]「どっちも！ぽっかぽかだもん」 とあおむしさん。
